T: Some men are coming to kill us. Dinner first.
D: Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt MI6.
P: Serve the mains when Bond and M reach the old family lodge in the Scottish highlands.
S: Pork and prawn siu mai: mince, chopped prawn, ginger, shiitake and soy wrapped in open wonton skins, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of roe on top.
the glass tower fight in Shanghai
Steamed bao filled with sticky pork belly braised in soy, Shaoxing wine and sugar for 2 hours, pickled cucumber, crushed peanuts and coriander.
Oatcakes of oats, butter and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, topped with crème fraîche, Scottish smoked salmon and dill.
M: the old lodge in the Scottish highlands
Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, thyme and pepper, seared to rare, rested, with a whisky and redcurrant sauce, mashed neeps and roast potatoes.
a Scottish soup for a cold night in the lodge
Smoked haddock poached in milk, flaked, potato and leek cooked in butter, the milk added, partly mashed and finished with cream and chives.
W: a Scottish dessert for the highlands
Oats toasted in a dry pan until nutty, folded through cream whipped with honey and a splash of whisky, layered in glasses with raspberries crushed lightly, more oats on top.
K: the very old whisky Silva pours on his island
30ml good single malt Scotch whisky neat in a tumbler, a few drops of water to open it up.

s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 3 chopped shiitake and 1 tbsp soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides and steam 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of roe.
Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Press thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Top with crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon, dill and lemon.

m.note: the old lodge in the Scottish highlands
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear to rare and rest. Add 60ml whisky, 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly and 150ml stock to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g swede with butter. Roast 800g potatoes.

w.note: a Scottish dessert for the highlands
w.how: Toast 60g oats in a dry pan until nutty. Whip 400ml cream with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp whisky. Lightly crush 300g raspberries. Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

d.note: the very old whisky Silva pours on his island
d.how: Pour 30ml good single malt Scotch into each of four tumblers. Add a few drops of water to open it up. Sip it slowly by the fire.
